context_for_next_testing_agent: Guide mascot system fully tested. Onboarding tour shows on first visit (AsyncStorage does not persist on web preview between page loads - expected behavior). Mascot bubble at bottom-right opens context-sensitive guide panel. All guide texts are in guideData.ts and support German/Italian. The mascot does not interfere with existing navigation or CTAs. Note: To test the Guide Panel on different screens, navigate to that screen first, then click the mascot bubble - the content will be context-specific per screen.

notes.asyncstorage_behavior: On web preview, AsyncStorage does not persist between page loads, so onboarding tour shows every time. This is expected - state persists properly on native devices.
